rules.description: Thumb layer: hold right Command (Advantage2: right Ctrl). Generated by bin/karabiner-gen-config; edit that, not this file
Thumb layer: app jumps, window management, volume and more (spec 3)
Thumb layer: swallow unbound keys, so Thumb+key never types
Reorganise mode: q or Escape leaves it
Terminals and Orca: Ctrl+Shift+C/V copy and paste; Orca attention cycling
PC-style editing outside terminals, Emacs, VMs and Orca (spec 2.5)
Bottom row: Control position is Command except in terminals, Emacs, VMs and Orca; Compose position is Command; MacBook left control is fn
MacBook keyboard: left-hand letters one column left (spec 2.1)
